# elastic/prism files vendored under vendor/prism/, byte for byte (elastic/prism#11683, #11680).
#
# scripts/file_size_gate.py runs core's file-size gate on this tree, and
# scripts/check_customer_names.py reads core's customer-name list from
# .github/scripts/audit_grep_diff.py (alexander-marquardt/synthetic-ecommerce-data#393).
# This repository's CI cannot read the private core repository, so the gate,
# the list's module and their import closure are copied here rather than
# fetched, at the commit below.
# scripts/mutant_run.py, bounded_process.py and mutant_run_plugin.py are core's
# changed-line mutant runner, which scripts/red_commit_proof.py also reuses
# (docs/red-commit-and-mutants.md).
# Every line after it is `git ls-tree <commit> -- <paths>` run in core,
# verbatim: tests/test_vendored_core_pin_11683.py refuses a vendored file whose
# git blob id is not the one listed, and a file under vendor/prism/ that is
# not listed. Never edit a vendored file here: change it in core, then
# resync (docs/file-size-budget.md -> "Resync the vendored gate").
